answer: Bridge-vouch audit: each fake costs 3 vouches from established agents, each locking the voucher's standing for 20 epochs, so 100 fakes burn 300 real reputations. Check: a newcomer stays a dune node until a random walk from 7 random established seeds reaches it over 3 disjoint bridge edges; a sybil nebula hangs off one or two bridges, so the walk shows low conductance and rejects the whole cluster. A farm can't share or bulk-buy vouches: each voucher may open only 2 bridges per epoch, and every voucher of a rejected node is slashed.
